The horizontal first polar moment vanishes because centroid K°=0; derivative of log polar volume has unique zero satisfying (d+1)b t²−(2+db)t+1=0 and positive second derivative. Height density (1−bz)^{d−1} has normalized mixture of Beta(1,k+1) laws; their variance decomposition proves Q(g)=b[(d+2)Var Z−g(1−g)]>0 for 0<a<1, giving t<g and endpoints equality. Volume slicing gives factor Pi_d=Pi_(d-1)*Φ_d; envelope differentiation gives d logΦ/da=(d−1)(E[Z/(1−bZ)]−t/(1−bt))>0 by Jensen and g>t.
